wiktionary-ku.description: Kurdish language name. Remove the bracketed dialect annotation from the legacy display label.

cldr48-gn.description: Unicode CLDR 48 explicit self-name avañe’ẽ; retain the existing project capitalization.

cldr48-ht.description: Unicode CLDR 48 explicit self-name Kreyòl Ayisyen; retain the existing project capitalization.

cldr48-nv.description: Unicode CLDR 48 explicit self-name Diné Bizaad; retain the existing project capitalization.

wiktionary-lt.description: Lithuanian genitive plural, used in the language name; dictionary stress mark retained.

wiktionary-ny.description: Chichewa section, native proper noun with ŵ and high-tone acute; preserve the existing Chewa naming choice rather than substitute Nyanja.

wiktionary-dv.description: Dhivehi proper noun; retain the existing short language name rather than expand it to the compound ending in bas.

wiktionary-syr.description: Classical Syriac section. Retain the unpointed Classical Syriac name; do not import the differently scoped Assyrian Neo-Aramaic vocalization.

wiktionary-bs.description: Language noun with short rising pitch accent and post-accentual vowel length.

wiktionary-hr.description: Language noun with short rising pitch accent on syllabic r and post-accentual vowel lengths.

wiktionary-sr.description: Cyrillic spelling of the language noun sȑpskī; short falling pitch accent on syllabic r and post-accentual vowel length. Preserve the existing Cyrillic script choice.

wiktionary-sl.description: Slovene language noun with the dictionary headword’s tonal accent and close-e dot below; use the full headword rather than the non-tonal declension spelling.

wiktionary-ppl.description: Pipil language noun nāwat, with long initial ā. Retain the existing project capitalization Nāwat.

wiktionary-nci.description: Classical Nahuatl language noun nāhuatlahtōlli, with vowel-length macrons and h representing saltillo. The entry cites Karttunen (1983), An Analytical Dictionary of Nahuatl, p. 158; distinct from the Central Nahuatl section.
